Evaluate a SimtablR analysis specification

Source: R/compute.R
evaluate.Rd

Turns an inert simtab_spec into a simtab_result by running the shared, engine-agnostic validator, resolving one registered engine, running that engine's own hard-error validator (if any), and wrapping the engine's raw numeric output in the namespaced result subclass the engine registered. Passing an existing simtab_result recomputes from its stored specification.

Usage

evaluate(spec)

Arguments

spec

A simtab_spec, or a simtab_result to recompute.

Value

A simtab_result.

Examples

sp <- simtab(epitabl) |> describe(hypertension) |> stratify(adjudicated_acs)
res <- evaluate(sp)
res
#> Characteristic                  Overall (N=1500)   No (N=928)  Yes (N=572) 
#> --------------------------------------------------------------------------
#> History of hypertension, n (%)                                             
#>   No                                 732 (48.8%)  463 (49.9%)  269 (47.0%) 
#>   Yes                                768 (51.2%)  465 (50.1%)  303 (53.0%)
